answers.question: Which platforms are in use, and how are they reached?
answers.answer: Side platform at track 1 (254 m, 470 mm high, 6.4 m wide) and island platform for tracks 2 and 3 (238 m, 600 mm, 5.4 m). Track 1 platform is step-free from the street; the island platform is reached by the footbridge (overgangsbro) with lift and stairs. Entur NSR lists rail quays 1, 2, 3. OSM maps only platform 1.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-m-/moss/, read 2026-10-30; Entur NSR stop register, NSR:StopPlace:58796 children (rail NSR:StopPlace:203; buses NSR:StopPlace:204, 3017), https://api.entur.io/stop-places/v1/read/stop-places/NSR:StopPlace:58796/children, read 2026-10-30 (NLOD); OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_no/NO-MOS.json), read 2026-10-30

answers.question: Old or new Moss station?
answers.answer: The old station is in service. Bane NOR's track plan is labelled 'midlertidig anlegg'; the Jan 2026 project presentation lists tunnels and civil works still in progress and gives no opening date for the new station.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-m-/moss/, read 2026-10-30; Moss kommune, Bane NOR presentation 'SMS-prosjektet' (002-2026, 23 Jan 2026), https://www.moss.kommune.no/_f/p1/i6c122378-6992-4bc4-9088-3090b5744a27/002-2026-presentasjon-sms-prosjektet-bane-nor-23226.pdf, read 2026-10-30

answers.question: Bane NOR's English page is out of date: it says the station is 'not adapted for the disabled', with a level crossing with steps between the platforms and a mobile lifting platform on track 1. The Norwegian page describes the footbridge with lift and stairs. Norwegian page used.
answers.answer: Lifts serve platform 1, platform 2/3 (The geometry supports the Norwegian page's footbridge-with-lifts description. Two footbridge lifts (0;2): n9697729520 lies 1.8 m from the platform 1 outline, and n9697729517 lies inside the island 2/3 outline r10173394. The English page's 'not adapted' text is out of date. Lift positions are OSM only.)
